items.topic: 账户：可选签名算法的交易
items.title: 新 EIP：Scheme-Agile Transactions
items.note: （Giulio2002）合并：新增 EIP-2718 类型 `0x05` 的 SchemedTransaction，EOA 通过 `scheme_id` 选择签名算法，首批三种为 secp256k1（与现有地址推导兼容）、P256/secp256r1（passkey、WebAuthn、Secure Enclave）和 Falcon-512（后量子，FIPS 206）；字段与 EIP-1559 相同，只把 `v, r, s` 换成 `scheme_id` 加签名数据，非 secp256k1 方案的地址带方案前缀以避免跨方案碰撞，后量子签名体积约大 10 倍并收取额外 gas。
items.note_en: (Giulio2002), merged: a `0x05` EIP-2718 SchemedTransaction lets EOAs pick a signature algorithm via `scheme_id`, launching with secp256k1 (same address derivation as today), P256/secp256r1 (passkeys, WebAuthn, Secure Enclave) and Falcon-512 (post-quantum, FIPS 206); fields match EIP-1559 with `v, r, s` replaced by `scheme_id` plus signature data, non secp256k1 addresses carry a scheme prefix to avoid cross scheme collisions, and post-quantum signatures, about 10x larger, pay a gas surcharge.

summary_en: At ACDE #235, Nixo was named co-lead of ACD, bal-devnet-3 was running well at a 100M gas limit, complexity concerns were raised about EIP-8037, and non-headliners such as EIP-8237 were proposed for Hegotá. Giulio2002's Scheme-Agile Transactions EIP was merged, adding a `0x05` type that lets EOAs choose secp256k1, P256 or Falcon-512 signatures via `scheme_id`. ProtocolGuild explained that Hegotá will be headlined by FOCIL.
